subject.title: [Bug]: publishable plugin runtime builds cannot emit native CJS entrypoints

question: Should `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` be accepted as the package-build knob for publishing msteams with native `.cjs` runtime sidecars?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix adds package build metadata and changes official installed-plugin startup artifacts, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive maintainer territory.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 is repaired and reviewed, then land it if the CJS package contract is accepted.

options.title: Keep publishable runtime packages ESM-only
options.body: Reject or redesign the linked PR if maintainers do not want official plugin packages to emit native CJS sidecars.

options.title: Choose another packaging contract
options.body: Keep the issue open but replace `runtimeFormat` with the preferred package-build or manifest mechanism before publishing msteams artifacts.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 is repaired and reviewed, then land it if the CJS package contract is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the package-local runtime build helper and package metadata path this issue targets.
